items.infer: データセンター新設に伴い、電源設備・冷却装置・搬送設備などの需要が発生する可能性(推論)。
items.verbatim: WEDC Technical Assistance under the Data Center Sales and Use Tax Exemption program, awarded 2024-09-24 in City of Verona, Dane County. Industry: Info and Comm. Planned project cost: $347,000,000. Planned capital investment: $150,000,000. Deliverables: Capital Investment.
